load_llama_model: load a LLaMA model from the model hub using get_llama_model_hub().load_model()
create_llama_model: create a new LLaMA model from config using get_llama_model_hub().create_new_model()
list_llama_models: iterate over all available LLaMA model cards using get_llama_model_hub().iter_cards()
load_llama_tokenizer: load a LLaMA tokenizer from the hub using get_llama_tokenizer_hub().load_tokenizer()
get_llama_archs: get the set of supported LLaMA architectures using get_llama_model_hub().get_archs()
